article.headline: Apple Edges Higher, Trading 1.5% Below Its 52-Week High
article.deck: Apple sits 2.9% above its 345.44 flat-base buy point and inside the buy range that runs to 362.71.
body: Apple rose 1.32 to 355.39, up 0.4%, as of 12:31 p.m. Mountain, on pace for 0.84x its 50-day average volume. The stock broke out of a four-week flat base, 5.7% deep, on Oct. 22, when it traded 1.17x its average. The buy point is 345.44 and the buy range runs to 362.71; today's price is 2.9% above the buy point, inside the range.

That breakout is 24 sessions old. The 52-week high is 360.83, 1.5% overhead. Apple trades above its 21-day line at 348.83, 3.6% above its 50-day line at 343.04 and 16.8% above its 200-day line at 304.40. It reads 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line, so the move is not stretched, and the desk flags the name for a bounce off its 50-day line. RS rank is 85 of 99 on the desk's list, and the RS line is 0.4% below its high. The stock is up 30.7% this year and 28.8% over one year.

Revenue for the September quarter was $114.48 billion, up 11.7% from a year earlier. The June quarter's EPS of 2.02 was up 28.7%. The next report is due Jan. 28, 2027. At a $5.17 trillion market value, the stock trades at 33.6 times forward earnings.
A close back under 345.44 would turn this into a stalled breakout. Until then the chart is in range.
article.watch: Watch the 360.83 52-week high above and the 345.44 buy point below.

article.headline: Fastenal Climbs 1.5% Despite Calls That The Stock Looks Rich
article.deck: Fastenal is back at its 53.02 flat-base buy point, at the bottom of a buy range that runs to 55.67.
body: Fastenal rose 0.76 to 53.03, up 1.5%, as of 12:31 p.m. Mountain, on pace for 0.57x its 50-day average volume. The stock broke out of a 12-week flat base, 10.6% deep, on Nov. 4, trading 1.48x its average that day. The buy point is 53.02 and the buy range runs to 55.67. After a pullback, today's price sits right on the buy point, 0.0% above it.

The breakout is 15 sessions old. The 52-week high is 56.27, 5.8% away. Fastenal trades just over its 21-day line at 52.99 and 2.2% above its 50-day line at 51.87, and the desk flags a bounce off that line. It reads 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line, so the move is not stretched. RS rank is 75 of 99 on the desk's list, and the RS line is 0.8% below its high. The stock is up 32.1% this year.

September-quarter EPS of 0.35 rose 20.7% and revenue of $2.46 billion rose 15.5%. Quarterly EPS has climbed from 0.26 to 0.30 to 0.33 to 0.35 over the four quarters given, and revenue from $2.03 billion to $2.46 billion. The next report is due Jan. 19, 2027. The company is valued at $60.9 billion and trades at 37.5 times forward earnings.

The headlines lean on valuation: Simply Wall St. wrote that the stock looks rich after a 93% five-year run, and Barron's ran a piece on why it is time to sell two industrial stocks. 24/7 Wall St. noted Fastenal raised its dividend twice in 2026.
A close below 53.02 puts the breakout under water.
article.watch: Watch whether Fastenal holds the 53.02 buy point and the 51.87 50-day line.

article.headline: SailPoint Rises 2.6% Following Its 1Kosmos Identity Security Partnership
article.deck: SailPoint is 6.4% below the 24.10 buy point of a 57-week deep cup; the live early entry is a move above today's high of 22.97.
body: SailPoint rose 0.57 to 22.55, up 2.6%, as of 12:31 p.m. Mountain, on pace for 0.69x its 50-day average volume. The stock is building a 57-week deep cup, 57.1% deep, from an Oct. 6, 2025 high to an April 10 low. The buy point is 24.10 and the buy range runs to 25.31; today's price is 6.4% below the buy point.

The 52-week high is 23.54, 4.2% overhead, against a low of 10.30. SailPoint trades 7.1% above its 21-day line at 21.06, 9.9% above its 50-day line at 20.53 and 37.2% above its 200-day line at 16.44. It reads 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line. RS rank is 94 of 99 on the desk's list, and the RS line is 0.5% below its high. The desk's early entries: the stock already trades 5.3% above the 21.42 handle high from Nov. 11, and today it flags a 50-day bounce, with the entry above today's high of 22.97 and the line as the stop.

Revenue for the July quarter was $308.8 million, up 16.8% from a year earlier. The company is still losing money: EPS was -0.09, after -0.13 the quarter before. The next report is due Dec. 8, inside the next two weeks. The company is valued at $12.9 billion and trades at 56.1 times forward earnings.
Simply Wall St. covered SailPoint's partnership with 1Kosmos, an onboarding security tie-up. Insider Monkey reported the company posted growth and a wider loss, and that Truist still says buy.

article.headline: CleanSpark Falls 5.4% Premarket After Revenue Miss And Data Center Delays
article.deck: Not buyable: the stock trades 78.4% below the 23.71 buy point of a 56-week deep cup and sits at its 52-week low.
body: CleanSpark fell 5.4%, or 0.27, to 4.84 in premarket trading as of 8:50 a.m. Eastern, the morning after the bitcoin miner reported its fiscal fourth quarter. That price matches the 52-week low of 4.84 set Nov. 20. On Tuesday the stock closed at 5.11, down 0.42, or 7.5%, and traded 1.1x its 50-day average volume. It sits in a 56-week deep cup, 79.5% deep, that began at the rim on Oct. 15, 2025; the buy point is 23.71 with a buy range to 24.90, and Tuesday's close was 78.4% below it.

No part of the chart is working. The close sat 73.3% below the 52-week high of 19.17, 45.9% under the 50-day line at 9.45 and 56.9% under the 200-day line at 11.87. The 21-day exponential line is at 6.73, and the stock is 1.72 ATRs below it. CleanSpark holds an RS rank of 6 of 99 on the desk's list, and its RS line is 71.3% below its high. The stock is down 49.5% this year and 47.4% over 12 months.

The quarters table shows a shrinking business. In the June quarter, the latest the desk has, CleanSpark lost 0.89 a share, an EPS change of -214.1% from a year earlier, and revenue fell 30.5% to $138.0 million. The two quarters before it were losses of 1.52 and 1.35 a share, and revenue has come down from $223.7 million in the September 2025 quarter. The next earnings date is Feb. 4, 2027.
InvestorsHub reported that the shares fell 3% as a revenue miss and data centre delays overshadowed an earnings beat. BeInCrypto asked why CleanSpark lost nearly $1 billion in fiscal 2026.
article.watch: Whether CleanSpark holds the 4.84 low from Nov. 20 once the regular session opens.

article.headline: Deere Drops 4.0% Premarket As Quarterly Profit Falls, Misses Estimates
article.deck: Not buyable: the premarket price undercuts the low of a nine-week cup with a 721.32 buy point, 14.9% above Tuesday's close.
body: Deere fell 4.0%, or 24.26, to 589.50 in premarket trading as of 8:50 a.m. Eastern after it reported fiscal fourth-quarter results. The Wall Street Journal reported that quarterly profit fell as sales of large agricultural equipment declined, and InvestorsHub reported that earnings missed expectations despite stronger-than-forecast revenue. On Tuesday, ahead of the report, the stock closed at 613.76, down 19.27, or 3.0%, and traded 1.78x its 50-day average volume.

Deere has been building a nine-week cup, 16.1% deep, with a buy point of 721.32 and a buy range to 757.39. Tuesday's close was 14.9% below the buy point. The premarket price sits under the base's 605.34 low from Nov. 20, so the cup is being undercut, and the early entry at the 699.01 handle high from Nov. 12 is now far overhead.

The close sat 7.2% under the 50-day line at 661.56 and under the 21-day exponential line at 649.70, 0.54 ATRs below it. It closed 0.2% below the 200-day line at 615.30, and the premarket price is under that line as well. The 52-week high is 721.22. Deere holds an RS rank of 64 of 99 on the desk's list, its RS line is 11.7% off its high, and the stock is still up 31.8% this year.

In the July quarter, the latest in the desk's table, EPS rose 7.4% to 5.10 and revenue rose 4.8% to $12.35 billion. The April quarter earned 6.55 a share on $13.09 billion in revenue. Deere carries a market cap of $165.5 billion and a forward P/E of 26.79.
A move back over the 200-day line would put the stock back inside its base; a session below it leaves the cup broken.
article.watch: Whether Deere can retake the 605.34 base low and the 200-day line at 615.30 in the regular session.

article.headline: Analog Devices Falls 3.2% More Premarket After Worst Day Since 1998
article.deck: Not buyable: the stock trades 29.8% below the 446.01 buy point of a 22-week cup and is undercutting the base's low.
body: Analog Devices slipped another 3.2%, or 9.94, to 303.01 in premarket trading as of 8:51 a.m. Eastern, a day after the stock fell 65.80, or 17.4%, to 312.95. 24/7 Wall St. called Tuesday the stock's worst day since 1998. The drop came on volume 3.13x the 50-day average after the chipmaker reported fiscal fourth-quarter results; Zacks reported that earnings beat estimates on industrial and data center strength.

The plunge took the stock to the bottom of a 22-week cup that is now 31.8% deep, with a buy point of 446.01 and a buy range to 468.31. Tuesday's close was 29.8% below the buy point, and the premarket price is under the 304.23 low the base set Tuesday.

The close sat 20.8% below the 50-day line at 395.02 and 17.3% below the 200-day line at 378.36, and 1.79 ATRs under the 21-day exponential line at 382.18. The 52-week high is 445.91. Analog Devices holds an RS rank of 47 of 99 on the desk's list, and its RS line is 27.1% off its high. The stock has lost 23.3% in a month but is still up 15.4% this year and 34.7% over 12 months.

The quarters before this report were strong. In the July quarter, the latest in the desk's table, EPS rose 163.5% to 2.74 and revenue rose 39.6% to $4.02 billion. EPS climbed every quarter in the table, from 1.60 in the October 2025 quarter to 1.69, 2.40 and 2.74, and revenue rose from $3.08 billion to $3.16 billion, $3.62 billion and $4.02 billion. The stock trades at a forward P/E of 15.76 on a market cap of $151.1 billion. The next earnings date is Feb. 17, 2027.
article.watch: Whether the regular session holds Tuesday's 304.23 low or the stock keeps trading under it toward the 303.01 premarket price.
